entries.headline: I'm hardening LedgerWatch's Django backend and drilling DSA for SWE and AI roles.

highlights.summary: Merged PR #67 fixing an org-matching bug in seed_transactions, which now requires an existing org; refreshed PRD and README to match the current API.
30 commits of NeetCode submissions, mostly heaps, intervals and DP: burst-balloons, edit-distance, regular-expression-matching, resubmitted several times.

entries.note_to_future_self: This is the first write-up with no earlier entries in memory, so there is nothing to compare against yet. Next week, check whether LedgerWatch gets a new concrete change to report instead of repeating the PRD and README update.

entries.headline: I'm documenting LedgerWatch's current scope and API while drilling LLD patterns for backend roles.

highlights.summary: Merged PRs #72 and #73, which align the README setup and PRD scope with the current API and design. The backend keeps views thin, with business logic in services and pluggable analyzers built through a factory.

Added car rental and file search systems, plus LRU cache and circular queue/deque implementations (ring buffer), each from a vague ChatGPT-generated spec. The circular structures were rewritten after stale files were removed.

entries.note_to_future_self: Last week and this week both lead with LedgerWatch docs PRs, so next week lead with a code change or say plainly that no code landed, rather than reusing the README/PRD wording. Keep the LLD highlight to one concrete design per week.
